# Techs

Every tech in the current rules. *Cost* is the tier stored in the data; the price a player pays depends on how many cities they own (table below). *Requires* are the techs that unlock this one (owning any one of them is enough). Tribes swap some techs for their own, see the override tables in [tribes.md](tribes.md).

## Price

The price is `ceil(cities * cost + 4)` stars, and a free tech (cost 0) stays free. With the Literacy ability (from philosophy) the sum is multiplied by 0.6667 before rounding up. The table is computed with `rules::economy::tech_price`, the function the engine uses.

| Cost tier | Literacy | 1 city | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | no | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 | 12 | 14 | 16 |
| 1 | yes | 4 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 10 | 11 |
| 2 | no | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 14 | 16 | 20 | 24 | 28 |
| 2 | yes | 4 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 10 | 11 | 14 | 16 | 19 |
| 3 | no | 7 | 10 | 13 | 16 | 19 | 22 | 28 | 34 | 40 |
| 3 | yes | 5 | 7 | 9 | 11 | 13 | 15 | 19 | 23 | 27 |

## Tree

The standard tree, following `tech_unlocks` from `basic`. A tech reachable from two parents is expanded under the first and marked `(above)` under the others.

- `basic` (cost 0)
  - `riding` (cost 1)
    - `freespirit` (cost 2)
      - `chivalry` (cost 3)
    - `roads` (cost 2)
      - `trade` (cost 3)
  - `organization` (cost 1)
    - `shields` (cost 2)
      - `diplomacy` (cost 3)
    - `farming` (cost 2)
      - `construction` (cost 3)
  - `fishing` (cost 1)
    - `sailing` (cost 2)
      - `navigation` (cost 3)
    - `ramming` (cost 2)
      - `aquatism` (cost 3)
  - `hunting` (cost 1)
    - `forestry` (cost 2)
      - `mathematics` (cost 3)
    - `archery` (cost 2)
      - `spiritualism` (cost 3)
  - `climbing` (cost 1)
    - `meditation` (cost 2)
      - `philosophy` (cost 3)
    - `mining` (cost 2)
      - `smithery` (cost 3)

Techs the standard tree does not reach. A tribe reaches them by replacing a standard tech (who is in the last column):

| `fishingsimple` | - | - |
| `sledding` | - | `polaris` (aquaculture) |
| `icefishing` | - | `polaris` (sailing) |
| `pescetism` | - | - |
